task_completion.description: Fetch the pBR322 sequence (J01749.1) and save it to ~/UGENE_Data/results/pBR322.gb
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE interface showing the pBR322 sequence loaded or a file explorer window showing pBR322.gb in the results directory.

task_completion.description: Load the human insulin gene sequence from ~/UGENE_Data/human_insulin_gene.gb
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE Project View or Sequence View showing human_insulin_gene.gb as an open document.

task_completion.description: Insert the insulin gene sequence exactly after nucleotide position 375 of the pBR322 vector.
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE 'Insert Sequence' dialog box with position 375 specified, or the cursor placed at position 375/376 during the edit operation.

task_completion.description: Save the recombinant sequence as a GenBank file at ~/UGENE_Data/results/pBR322_insulin_recombinant.gb.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export as GenBank' or 'Save As' dialog showing the specific file path and filename in the results directory.

task_completion.description: Create a plain text report at ~/UGENE_Data/results/cloning_report.txt with the total length of the final plasmid.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or UGENE's internal editor) showing the file cloning_report.txt with a numerical value representing the total base pairs.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI to perform cloning operations rather than just using terminal commands to manipulate files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the UGENE application window active, menus being clicked, and sequence visualization.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed the insertion in the editor rather than just renaming the input file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence length in the UGENE status bar or sequence view should be the sum of the vector (4361 bp) and the insulin gene.

integrity.description: The cloning report was generated after the sequence manipulation was visible in the GUI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Timestamp or sequence of screenshots showing the report being written after the recombinant file was saved.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The pBR322 vector (J01749.1) is exactly 4361 bp long. The insertion point 375 is the BamHI site. The final length in the cloning_report.txt should be 4361 plus the length of the human_insulin_gene.gb sequence (NM_000207.3 is approx 446-500bp depending on the specific record version, but the VLM should verify the math: 4361 + [insulin_length]).
